forecast: 今日太陽黑子位於表面中央及右側，黑子數預估為70-90，預期太陽活動為緩和至微弱等級。今日太陽輻射通量稍高，預期對日側地區之高頻通訊(3-8MHz)造成干擾或中斷。預估未來太陽風風速為每秒300至500公里之間，太陽風密度小幅度擾動，行星際磁場小幅度擾動，預期地磁擾動為緩和等級(Kp小於等於4)。總結，未來近地太空環境稍不穩定，另受活躍區短暫變化影響，請日側地區高頻通訊服務使用者多加留意。
forecast_en: Today's sunspots are located in the center and right side of the surface. The number of sunspots is estimated to be 70-90. Solar activity is expected to moderate to weak levels. The solar radiation flux is slightly higher today, which is expected to cause interference or interruption to high-frequency communications (3-8MHz) in the sunside area. It is estimated that the solar wind speed in the future will be between 300 and 500 kilometers per second, the solar wind density will be slightly disturbed, the interplanetary magnetic field will be slightly disturbed, and the geomagnetic disturbance is expected to be at a moderate level (Kp less than or equal to 4). In summary, the near-Earth space environment will be slightly unstable in the future and will be affected by temporary changes in active areas. Users of high-frequency communication services in the sunside area are asked to pay more attention.
report: 昨日太陽黑子位於表面中央及右側，太陽黑子數為88，太陽活動屬於緩和等級。昨日太陽輻射通量稍高，對日側地區之高頻通訊(3-7MHz)造成短暫干擾或中斷。昨日太陽風密度微幅擾動，行星際磁場微幅擾動，最大風速達約每秒387公里，地磁擾動為緩和等級(Kp最大值為2)。
report_en: Yesterday, the sunspots were located in the center and right side of the surface. The number of sunspots was 88, and the solar activity was at a moderate level. Yesterday, the solar radiation flux was slightly higher, causing temporary interference or interruption to high-frequency communications (3-7MHz) in the sunside area. Yesterday, the solar wind density was slightly disturbed, the interplanetary magnetic field was slightly disturbed, the maximum wind speed reached about 387 kilometers per second, and the geomagnetic disturbance was at a moderate level (the maximum Kp value was 2).
